BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.acceptFi.description: Whether clicking an inactive window will also click through to the web contents. Default is `false` on macOS. This option is not configurable on other platforms.

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.alwaysOn.description: Whether the window should always stay on top of other windows. Default is `false`.

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.autoHide.description: Auto hide the menu bar unless the `Alt` key is pressed. Default is `false`.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.autoHide.name: autoHideMenuBar

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.backgrou.description: The window's background color in Hex, RGB, RGBA, HSL, HSLA or named CSS color format. Alpha in #AARRGGBB format is supported if `transparent` is set to `true`. Default is `#FFF` (white). See win.setBackgroundColor for more information.

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.backgrou.description: Set the window's system-drawn background material, including behind the non-client area. Can be `auto`, `none`, `mica`, `acrylic` or `tabbed`. See win.setBackgroundMaterial for more information.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.backgrou.name: backgroundMaterial

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.center.description: Show window in the center of the screen. Default is `false`.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.center.name: center

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.closable.description: Whether window is closable. This is not implemented on Linux. Default is `true`.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.closable.name: closable

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.darkThem.description: Forces using dark theme for the window, only works on some GTK+3 desktop environments. Default is `false`.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.darkThem.name: darkTheme

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.disableA.description: Whether to hide cursor when typing. Default is `false`.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.disableA.name: disableAutoHideCursor

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.enableLa.description: Enable the window to be resized larger than screen. Only relevant for macOS, as other OSes allow larger-than-screen windows by default. Default is `false`.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.enableLa.name: enableLargerThanScreen

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.focusabl.description: Whether the window can be focused. Default is `true`. On Windows setting `focusable: false` also implies setting `skipTaskbar: true`. On Linux setting `focusable: false` makes the window stop interacting with wm, so the window will always stay on top in all workspaces.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.focusabl.name: focusable

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.frame.description: Specify `false` to create a frameless window. Default is `true`.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.frame.name: frame

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.fullscre.description: Whether the window should show in fullscreen. When explicitly set to `false` the fullscreen button will be hidden or disabled on macOS. Default is `false`.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.fullscre.name: fullscreen

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.fullscre.description: Whether the window can be put into fullscreen mode. On macOS, also whether the maximize/zoom button should toggle full screen mode or maximize window. Default is `true`.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.fullscre.name: fullscreenable

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.hasShado.description: Whether window should have a shadow. Default is `true`.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.hasShado.name: hasShadow

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.height.description: Window's height in pixels. Default is `600`.

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.hiddenIn.description: Whether window should be hidden when the user toggles into mission control.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.hiddenIn.name: hiddenInMissionControl

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.icon.description: The window icon. On Windows it is recommended to use `ICO` icons to get best visual effects, you can also leave it undefined so the executable's icon will be used.

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.kiosk.description: Whether the window is in kiosk mode. Default is `false`.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.kiosk.name: kiosk

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.maxWidth.description: Window's maximum width. Default is no limit.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.maxWidth.name: maxWidth

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.maximiza.description: Whether window is maximizable. This is not implemented on Linux. Default is `true`.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.maximiza.name: maximizable

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.minimiza.description: Whether window is minimizable. This is not implemented on Linux. Default is `true`.

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.opacity.name: opacity

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.paintWhe.description: Whether the renderer should be active when `show` is `false` and it has just been created. BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.resizabl.description: Whether window is resizable. Default is `true`.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.resizabl.name: resizable

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.show.description: Whether window should be shown when created. Default is `true`.

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.simpleFu.description: Use pre-Lion fullscreen on macOS. Default is `false`.

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.skipTask.description: Whether to show the window in taskbar. Default is `false`.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.skipTask.name: skipTaskbar

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.titleBar.description: When using a frameless window in conjunction with `win.setWindowButtonVisibility(true)` on macOS or using a `titleBarStyle` so that the standard window controls ("traffic lights" on macOS) are visible, this property enables the Window Controls Overlay JavaScript APIs and CSS Environment Variables. BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.titleBar.description: The style of window title bar. Default is `default`. Possible values are:
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.titleBar.name: titleBarStyle

possibleValues.description: Results in the standard title bar for macOS or Windows respectively.

On Windows and Linux, when combined with `titleBarOverlay: true` it will activate the Window Controls Overlay (see `titleBarOverlay` for more information), otherwise no window controls will be shown.
Results in a hidden title bar with an alternative look where the traffic light buttons are slightly more inset from the window edge.

Results in a hidden title bar and a full size content window, the traffic light buttons will display when being hovered over in the top left of the window. **Note:** This option is currently experimental.

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.trafficL.description: Set a custom position for the traffic light buttons in frameless windows.

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.type.description: The type of window, default is normal window. See more about this below.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.type.name: type

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.useConte.name: useContentSize

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.vibrancy.description: Add a type of vibrancy effect to the window, only on macOS. BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.visualEf.description: Specify how the material appearance should reflect window activity state on macOS. Must be used with the `vibrancy` property. Possible values are:

possibleValues.description: The backdrop should automatically appear active when the window is active, and inactive when it is not. This is the default.

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.width.name: width

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.x.description: (**required** if y is used) Window's left offset from screen. Default is to center the window.
BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.x.name: x

BrowserWindowConstructorOptions.y.description: (**required** if x is used) Window's top offset from screen. Default is to center the window.
